data.title: Mabwell Reports Positive COPD Data for 9MW1911 Ahead of ERS 2026
data.description:
Mabwell (Shanghai) Bioscience Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:2493) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Mabwell (Shanghai) Bioscience Co., Ltd. will present updated Phase Ib/IIa clinical data for its innovative monoclonal antibody 9MW1911 in former smokers with moderate-to-severe COPD at the European Respiratory Society Congress 2026 in Barcelona. The drug, which blocks the IL-33/ST2 signalling pathway, is designed to reduce COPD exacerbations, a critical driver of morbidity and healthcare costs.

The study showed favourable safety and tolerability and revealed strong preliminary efficacy signals, including substantial reductions in annualised moderate-to-severe and severe COPD exacerbation rates in medium- and high-dose groups compared with placebo. These results underpin ongoing Phase IIb and planned Phase III trials in China and a FDA-cleared Phase IIa study in the U.S., although Mabwell cautions that regulatory outcomes remain uncertain and urges investors to consider associated development and approval risks.

data.title: Kangqiao Service Group Faces Setback as Supreme People’s Court Upholds Loan Judgment
data.description:
Kangqiao Service Group Limited ( (HK:2205) ) has shared an announcement.

Kangqiao Service Group Limited has provided an update on ongoing litigation involving its wholly owned subsidiary, Kangqiao Yueshenghuo Service Group Co., Ltd., relating to irregularities previously discovered in the subsidiary’s bank accounts and associated loan and collateral arrangements. The case centers on a Second Civil Judgment in China, which the company had sought to challenge through a retrial application to the Supreme People’s Court.

The Supreme People’s Court has now dismissed the subsidiary’s retrial application, finding that the evidence submitted on the alleged invalidity of the loan contracts and a promissory letter did not qualify as new evidence sufficient to overturn the original ruling. The court also held that arguments about connected guarantees and listing-rule-related disclosure and approval procedures lacked legal basis, and that the lending bank had carried out appropriate review and was not acting in bad faith.

At the same time, Kangqiao is considering negotiations with the bank to reach a mutually acceptable arrangement over the loan and related collateral to avoid disruption to the subsidiary’s normal operations and mitigate potential impact on business continuity.

The company has urged shareholders and potential investors to exercise caution in trading its shares while the situation develops, underlining that the unresolved litigation and the upheld Second Civil Judgment could have implications for its financial obligations and risk profile. data.title: United Laboratories Begins Phase III Dosing of Obesity Drug UBT251 in China
data.description:
The United Laboratories International Holdings ( (HK:3933) ) has shared an announcement.

The United Laboratories International Holdings announced that the first participant has been dosed in a Phase III randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial in China evaluating UBT251 Injection for overweight and obesity. The study will enroll 600 participants with obesity or overweight plus at least one weight-related comorbidity, measuring percentage weight change and the proportion achieving at least 5 percent weight loss after 52 weeks of treatment.

UBT251 is a long-acting triple-target receptor agonist and the company is the first in China, and second globally, to secure clinical trial approval for such a polypeptide-based therapy. The recent exclusive licensing agreement with Novo Nordisk A/S for UBT251 underscores the drug’s strategic importance, potentially strengthening United Laboratories’ position in the global metabolic disease market and signaling value creation for stakeholders if the Phase III results are successful.
